packages.title: Rounding money on long invoices: once per invoice, or once per line?
packages.frame: For invoices with many lines, which rounding rule keeps the total closest to the exact sum, and what does it cost when customers check totals in their own tools?

claims.text: Rounding every line and adding the results lets rounding errors build up on long invoices, the drift BUG-12 reports; keeping lines exact and rounding the total once, as ADR-007 does, removes it.
Sheet formulas round each line with halves away from zero, so P-3 would match them only by bringing the drift back.
People judge a total by whether it matches their own sheet, so a correct total a cent away will keep producing support tickets under ADR-007 unless the invoice explains its rounding.

questions.phrasing: Should an invoice total be rounded once, or line by line?
